questions.prompt: A bag has 6 red and 4 blue marbles. What is the probability of drawing red, as a fraction out of 10?
questions.why: 6 red out of 10 total marbles gives a probability of 6/10, which equals 0.6.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: The probability of picking a red counter is 0.7. What is the probability of not picking red?
questions.why: Complementary probabilities add to 1, so 1 minus 0.7 leaves 0.3 for not picking red.

questions.subject: Music
questions.prompt: In the key of C major, which chord is built on the fourth note of the scale?
questions.why: The fourth note of the C major scale is F, so the chord built on it is F (the 'IV' chord).
